We can leave the error message for `HOMEBREW_CORE_GIT_REMOTE` in `update-report`. And move the messages for `HOMEBREW_BOTTLE_DOMAIN` here (just leave a message to the user and fail, do not unset it and retry):

https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/blob/033c365b0da986efd8e5b7e14111e19afa6bdccf/Library/Homebrew/exceptions.rb#L712-L727

https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/blob/033c365b0da986efd8e5b7e14111e19afa6bdccf/Library/Homebrew/cmd/vendor-install.sh#L198-L207

@XuehaiPan Updated to add another `brew doctor` check and make the messages (hopefully) clearer. Can you take another look? Thanks!
